#                                         IMPORTANT TIPS 
  
> ## For information on how to install and use Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental, please see the official [Github page](https://github.com/ShmuelRonen/ComfyUI-Gemini_Flash_2.0_Exp).  
  
> ## You need to install [Creepy Nodes](https://github.com/Creepybits/ComfyUI-Creepy_nodes) for some of the switches to work. You can find the nodes on Github and in the manager.
  
> ## Tips for prompting 
> Mainly make changes for prompting in the Gemini System Prompt. There you will write instructions for how the model should interpret the input image, rather than a regular prompt.

> ## For Flux models 
>You can write a separate L-CLIP prompt for Flux models in the "Input Flux L-Clip Prompt".

> ## Image sizes
> The size of the output image is set in "Empty Latent" in group 3 for Flux models, "Empty Latent size picker" in group 2 for SDXL and SD 1.5 and in "PixArt Resolution Select" in group 1 for PixArt.

widgets_values:
#                                                 INSTRUCTIONS  
  
>## Input image
>Load the image you want to use as reference image  

>## Models & Loras
>Choose either "Pixart", "SDXL & SD 1.5" or "Flux & Shuttle 3.1" and enable the one you picked. If you want to use Lora together with your model, then activate the Loras that corresponds to your model.  

>### If using Lora
>Select your Loras in the group that corresponds to your selected model, "PixArt Lora", "SDXL Lora" or "Flux Lora". If you don't want to use all Lora loaders in the group, DO NOT BYPASS OR MUTE THEM, instead just set the strength to 0 (zero) on the Lora loaders you don't use.  

> ## Ksampler settings
> It's important to remember to change the settings of the Ksampler so it suits the model of your choice.
  
>### Load model
> Make sure you load your model located in the model loader in each group (1, 2 or 3).
  
> ## Special instructions for SD 1.5
> In order to use SD 1.5 you have to load the checkpoint in the SDXL & SD 1.5 model loader. You will also have to load the SD 1.5 VAE in the VAE loader and the Dual Clip Loader (click on the loader and then use ctrl+B). Don't forget to activate the loader again when changing to SDXL.
